component.name: Ithaca
component.summary: Play your music, and nothing else
Écouter votre musique, et rien d'autre
Ihre Musik abspielen, und sonst nichts

description.p: Ithaca is a small music player for GNOME, inspired by Amberol. It does not manage a library: open songs, folders or playlists and they join the play queue, which is remembered between sessions. It follows the desktop theme, or optionally tints the window after the album cover.

Ithaca est un petit lecteur de musique pour GNOME, inspiré d'Amberol. Pas de bibliothèque à gérer : on ouvre des morceaux, des dossiers ou des listes de lecture et ils rejoignent la file, retenue d'une session à l'autre. Il suit le thème du bureau, ou, en option, se teinte d'après la pochette.

Ithaca ist ein kleiner Musikplayer für GNOME, inspiriert von Amberol. Keine Bibliothek zu verwalten: Titel, Ordner oder Wiedergabelisten öffnen, und sie kommen in die Warteschlange, die zwischen den Sitzungen erhalten bleibt. Es folgt dem Thema der Arbeitsumgebung oder färbt das Fenster auf Wunsch nach dem Cover ein.

ul.li: Large cover art, waveform progress bar, gapless playback
Shuffle, repeat, search in the queue
Playlists (.m3u, .m3u8, .xspf, .pls) and web radios
ReplayGain, media keys and GNOME panel controls (MPRIS)
Background playback with a tray icon
Grande pochette, barre en forme d'onde, enchaînement sans blanc
Aléatoire, répétition, recherche dans la file
Listes de lecture (.m3u, .m3u8, .xspf, .pls) et webradios
ReplayGain, touches multimédia et contrôle depuis le panneau de GNOME (MPRIS)
Lecture en arrière-plan avec icône dans la barre système
Großes Cover, Wellenform-Leiste, lückenlose Wiedergabe
Zufallswiedergabe, Wiederholen, Suche in der Warteschlange
Wiedergabelisten (.m3u, .m3u8, .xspf, .pls) und Webradios
ReplayGain, Medientasten und Steuerung über die GNOME-Leiste (MPRIS)
Wiedergabe im Hintergrund mit Symbol in der Systemleiste
F1 and Ctrl+? open the keyboard shortcuts window, on every keyboard layout
The mouse wheel changes the volume anywhere on the player, not only on the volume slider
The playlist can open on the left or on the right of the window (Preferences → General)
The tray icon is the application icon; with a shell set to symbolic icons, a music note
Maximum volume of 100 % or 150 % (amplified above 100 %, like VLC)
Choose the jump of the arrow keys (5, 10 or 30 seconds) and the volume step of the mouse wheel
Web radios show the station logo, from the playlist (tvg-logo, XSPF image) or the station's website icon
Drag and drop to reorder the play queue
Space now always plays or pauses, even right after clicking a button (it used to press that button again)
Hiding the play queue (F9, buttons) shrinks the window to a compact player; showing it again restores the previous width
Play queue button in the header bar
Long song titles scroll slowly, with faded edges
New colorful tray icon, readable at small sizes
Tray icon: Ithaca's icon now shows with Ubuntu's AppIndicator extension (instead of a placeholder)
A presentation website, now the project homepage
First release: a small music player inspired by Amberol, for Ubuntu 24.04 / Zorin OS 18 without Flatpak
Cover art, waveform bar, gapless playback, shuffle, repeat, search in the queue
Playlists (.m3u, .m3u8, .xspf, .pls) and web radios with the title announced by the station
ReplayGain, MPRIS media controls, background playback with a tray icon
